_comment: Bundled MythicMobs 5.x reference used for documentation, completion and validation. Param format: 'names,comma,separated|type|default|description'. Types: number integer boolean string time skill skilllist mob item color material particle sound entitytype potion enum(A,B) (strict) enum~(A,B) (suggestions only) enum:<name> (see enums). A trailing '!' on the type marks a required parameter. Names detected from the installed MythicMobs at runtime are merged in and flagged source=runtime.

mechanics.name: damage
mechanics.desc: Deals damage to the target.
params: preventknockback,pkb|boolean|false|Do not knock the target back

mechanics.name: damagepercent
mechanics.desc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's health.
params: preventknockback,pkb|boolean|false|Do not knock the target back

mechanics.name: basedamage
mechanics.desc: Deals damage based on the caster's base Damage stat multiplied by a value.
params: preventknockback,pkb|boolean|false|Do not knock the target back

mechanics.name: heal
mechanics.desc: Restores health to the target.

mechanics.name: healpercent
mechanics.desc: Restores a percentage of the target's max health.
params: percent,p,amount,a|number|10|Percent of max health to restore

mechanics.name: threat
mechanics.desc: Adds (or removes with a negative value) threat for the caster on the target's threat table.

mechanics.name: explosion
mechanics.desc: Creates an explosion at the target location.

mechanics.name: lightning
mechanics.desc: Strikes lightning at the target location.

mechanics.name: ignite
mechanics.desc: Sets the target on fire.

mechanics.name: extinguish
mechanics.desc: Puts out fire on the target.

mechanics.name: potion
mechanics.desc: Applies a potion effect to the target.

mechanics.name: projectile
mechanics.desc: Launches a projectile that runs skills while flying and when it hits.
params: onEnd,oe,onend|skill||Skill executed when the projectile ends
stopOnHitEntity,sohe|boolean|true|Stop when an entity is hit
stopOnHitBlock,sohb|boolean|true|Stop when a block is hit

mechanics.name: skill
mechanics.desc: Executes another Skill (metaskill). The shorthand skill:Name is equivalent.
params: skill,s,meta,m,name|skill!||Name of the Skill to execute

mechanics.name: sudoskill
mechanics.desc: Executes a Skill as if the target were the caster.
params: skill,s,meta,m|skill!||Name of the Skill to execute

mechanics.name: randomskill
mechanics.desc: Executes one random Skill from a list.

mechanics.name: delay
mechanics.desc: Delays the rest of the skill. Usage: '- delay 20'.

mechanics.name: aura
mechanics.desc: Applies an aura to the target that runs skills periodically.
params: onEnd,oe,onend|skill||Skill executed when the aura ends

mechanics.name: removeaura
mechanics.desc: Removes an aura from the target.

mechanics.name: summon
mechanics.desc: Spawns a MythicMob near the target.

mechanics.name: remove
mechanics.desc: Removes the target entity.

mechanics.name: setlevel
mechanics.desc: Sets the level of the target MythicMob.

mechanics.name: setowner
mechanics.desc: Sets the owner of the caster.

mechanics.name: settarget
mechanics.desc: Makes the caster target the specified entity.

mechanics.name: message
mechanics.desc: Sends a chat message to the target player.

mechanics.name: sendtitle
mechanics.desc: Shows a title to the target player.

mechanics.name: sendactionmessage
mechanics.desc: Shows an action bar message to the target player.

mechanics.name: command
mechanics.desc: Runs a command. Runs from console by default.

mechanics.name: sound
mechanics.desc: Plays a sound at the target location.

mechanics.name: effect:particles
mechanics.desc: Spawns particles at the target.

mechanics.name: effect:particlering
mechanics.desc: Spawns particles in a ring.

mechanics.name: effect:particleline
mechanics.desc: Draws a line of particles between caster and target.

mechanics.name: effect:particlesphere
mechanics.desc: Spawns particles in a sphere.

mechanics.name: effect:particletornado
mechanics.desc: Spawns a tornado of particles.

mechanics.name: effect:lightning
mechanics.desc: Visual lightning without damage.

mechanics.name: effect:explosion
mechanics.desc: Visual explosion without damage.

mechanics.name: glow
mechanics.desc: Makes the target glow.

mechanics.name: teleport
mechanics.desc: Teleports the caster to the target location.

mechanics.name: teleportto
mechanics.desc: Teleports the target to a fixed coordinate.

mechanics.name: throw
mechanics.desc: Throws the target upwards/away.

mechanics.name: leap
mechanics.desc: Makes the caster leap toward the target.

mechanics.name: pull
mechanics.desc: Pulls the target toward the caster.

mechanics.name: push
mechanics.desc: Pushes the target away from the caster.

mechanics.name: velocity
mechanics.desc: Modifies the target's velocity.

mechanics.name: lookat
mechanics.desc: Makes the caster look at the target.

mechanics.name: jump
mechanics.desc: Makes the caster jump.

mechanics.name: setgravity
mechanics.desc: Enables or disables gravity.

mechanics.name: mount
mechanics.desc: Makes the caster ride the target.

mechanics.name: mountme
mechanics.desc: Makes the target ride the caster.

mechanics.name: setvariable
mechanics.desc: Sets a variable on caster, target, skill or globally.

mechanics.name: giveitem
mechanics.desc: Gives an item to the target player.

mechanics.name: disguise
mechanics.desc: Disguises the target (requires LibsDisguises).

mechanics.name: undisguise
mechanics.desc: Removes the target's disguise.

mechanics.name: cancelevent
mechanics.desc: Cancels the event that triggered the skill (e.g. onDamaged).

mechanics.name: activatespawner
mechanics.desc: Activates a MythicMobs spawner.

mechanics.name: totem
mechanics.desc: Creates a totem entity that executes skills periodically.

mechanics.name: blockwave
mechanics.desc: Creates a visual wave of blocks.

mechanics.name: breakblock
mechanics.desc: Breaks the block at the target location.

mechanics.name: oxygen
mechanics.desc: Modifies the target's oxygen.

mechanics.name: feed
mechanics.desc: Feeds the target player.

mechanics.name: modifyscore
mechanics.desc: Modifies a scoreboard score.

targeters.name: Self
targeters.desc: The caster itself.

targeters.name: Target

targeters.name: Trigger
targeters.desc: The entity that triggered the skill (for example the attacker of an onDamaged trigger).

targeters.desc: The parent mob that spawned the caster.

targeters.name: Passenger

targeters.name: Vehicle
targeters.desc: The entity the caster is riding.

targeters.name: PlayersInRadius
targeters.desc: Players within a radius of the caster.

targeters.name: EntitiesInRadius
targeters.desc: All entities within a radius of the caster.

targeters.name: LivingEntitiesInRadius
targeters.desc: Living entities within a radius of the caster.

targeters.name: MobsInRadius
targeters.desc: MythicMobs within a radius of the caster.

targeters.name: PlayersInWorld
targeters.desc: All players in the caster's world.

targeters.name: PlayersOnServer
targeters.desc: All players on the server.

targeters.name: PlayersNearOrigin
targeters.desc: Players near the skill origin.

targeters.name: EntitiesNearOrigin
targeters.desc: Entities near the skill origin.

targeters.name: NearestPlayer
targeters.desc: The nearest player to the caster.

targeters.name: NearestEntity
targeters.desc: The nearest entity to the caster.

targeters.name: ThreatTable
targeters.desc: All entities on the caster's threat table.

targeters.name: ThreatTablePlayers
targeters.desc: Players on the caster's threat table.

targeters.name: TargetLocation
targeters.desc: The location of the current target.

targeters.name: SelfLocation
targeters.desc: The location of the caster.

targeters.name: TriggerLocation
targeters.desc: The location of the trigger.

targeters.name: Origin
targeters.desc: The origin location of the skill.

targeters.name: Location
targeters.desc: A fixed coordinate.

targeters.name: Forward
targeters.desc: A location in front of the caster.

targeters.name: Ring
targeters.desc: Locations forming a ring around the caster.

targeters.name: Sphere
targeters.desc: Locations forming a sphere.

targeters.name: Cone
targeters.desc: Entities inside a cone in front of the caster.

targeters.name: LineOfSight
targeters.desc: Entities on the caster's line of sight.

targeters.name: TargetedLocation
targeters.desc: The block location the caster is looking at.

targeters.name: RandomLocationNearCaster
targeters.desc: Random locations near the caster.

targeters.name: RandomLocationNearTarget
targeters.desc: Random locations near the target.

targeters.name: MobsInWorld
targeters.desc: All MythicMobs in the world.

targeters.name: Mob
targeters.desc: Specific MythicMobs by type.

targeters.name: Players
targeters.desc: Specific players.

triggers.name: onLoad
triggers.desc: When the mob is loaded (e.g. chunk load).

triggers.name: onReady
triggers.desc: When the mob is fully ready after spawning.

triggers.name: onAttack
triggers.desc: When the mob damages an entity in melee.

triggers.name: onCombat
triggers.desc: Repeatedly while the mob is in combat.

triggers.name: onSignal
triggers.desc: When a signal is received. Usage: ~onSignal:name

triggers.name: onInteract
triggers.desc: When a player right-clicks the mob.

triggers.name: onShoot
triggers.desc: When the mob shoots a projectile.

triggers.name: onKillPlayer
triggers.desc: When the mob kills a player.

triggers.name: onPlayerDeath
triggers.desc: When a player dies near the mob.

triggers.name: onUse
triggers.desc: When a spawn egg or item is used.

conditions.name: health
conditions.desc: Compares the entity's current health.

conditions.name: distance
conditions.desc: Distance between caster and target.

conditions.name: distancefromspawn
conditions.desc: Distance of the caster from its spawn point.

conditions.name: altitude
conditions.desc: Y level of the entity.

conditions.name: stance
conditions.desc: Whether the mob is in the given stance.

conditions.name: entitytype
conditions.desc: Whether the entity is one of the given entity types.

conditions.name: world
conditions.desc: Whether the entity is in one of the given worlds.

conditions.name: biome
conditions.desc: Whether the entity is in the given biome.

conditions.name: lightlevel
conditions.desc: Light level at the entity location.

conditions.name: day
conditions.desc: True during the day.

conditions.name: night
conditions.desc: True during the night.

conditions.name: raining
conditions.desc: True while it is raining.

conditions.name: thundering
conditions.desc: True during a thunderstorm.

conditions.name: outside
conditions.desc: True if the entity has open sky above.

conditions.name: crouching
conditions.desc: True if the entity is sneaking.

conditions.name: sprinting
conditions.desc: True if the entity is sprinting.

conditions.name: onground

conditions.name: flying

conditions.name: gliding

conditions.name: swimming

conditions.name: incombat

conditions.name: haspermission

conditions.name: holding

conditions.name: wearing

conditions.desc: True if the current target is within the given distance.

conditions.name: targetnotwithin

conditions.name: lineofsight

conditions.name: level

conditions.name: chance

conditions.name: time

skillKeys.name: Skills

mobOptions.name: DigOutOfGround

placeholders.desc: Current health of the trigger entity.
